_meta.grain: One row per order, proven by view-definition lineage.
_meta.metricPolicy: No business metric is defined. V1 is limited to bounded operational detail/list queries.
_meta.statusPolicy: order_status is selectable but not filterable because enum values were absent from metadata and the view definition.
_meta.capabilityEvidence: Equality filters are limited to explicit identifier/location text columns; date range uses order_purchase_timestamp; stable ordering is order_purchase_timestamp plus unique order_id.
